contentMap.targetAudience: Professionals seeking high-quality AI image and video generation, including creative directors, video producers, art directors, and enterprises

hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.
hero.supportingLine: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: Feature 1
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description:
Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs.
The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Capabilities of Seedream 4.5 by ByteDance
features.description: From accurate text rendering to consistent image editing and multi-image composition, Seedream 4.5 powers high-quality, professional visual creation with superior precision and control.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: Additional Feature:-
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description:
Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together.
Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Key Capabilities of Seedance 1.5 Pro
features.description: Seedance enables professional-grade AI video production with narrative coherence and realistic motion.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)
includes: Enhanced typographic rendering for posters, ads & text-heavy designs

plans.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro (AI Video Generation)
includes: Fast inference for quicker video production

testimonials.quote: Seedream allows us to generate high-resolution creative visuals from simple prompts. It has dramatically reduced our design turnaround time.
testimonials.author: Vaishali Saxena

testimonials.quote: Seedance’s ability to generate synchronized audio and video is incredibly powerful for storytelling and branded content.
testimonials.author: Vihaan Pandey

testimonials.quote: The multimodal editing capabilities in Seedream make it easy to refine images with precision.
testimonials.author: Anurag Malhotra

referenceMap.heroPattern: Full-width split hero with strong dark promotional band, brand/logo placement at top, large left-aligned headline, short supporting copy, and a compact value-prop bullet list beneath. Visual hierarchy prioritizes headline first, then proof points, then CTA area.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Top hero band followed by a high-contrast form section, then stacked content blocks for product features. Overall rhythm is linear and lead-gen focused, with each section serving a single job and limited lateral complexity.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Rectangular form card and content panels with simple borders, minimal ornamentation, and dense utility-oriented layout. Cards appear functional rather than decorative, with clear headings and tightly grouped fields or feature text.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA is placed in the hero and repeated in product-focused sections; CTAs are action-forward and conversion-oriented. Secondary actions are either absent or deprioritized, reinforcing a single dominant conversion path.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No pricing section pattern is visible in the reference structure.
referenceMap.footerMode: Footer is not present in the extracted reference structure; design behavior inferred as minimal or utilitarian if included.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Minimal media usage in the visible pattern: logo lockup in hero and simple icon bullets for benefits. No large illustrative media, but the layout supports product-led visual substitution in the hero band.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Stacked feature sections with a section label, strong headline, supporting paragraph, then a list of sub-features. Each product area behaves like a self-contained content module with progressive disclosure from overview to capability list.
referenceMap.formPattern: Dedicated lead form card placed immediately after hero, with a clear section heading and hidden tracking fields. Form appears optimized for conversion capture, not exploration, and is likely vertically compact with straightforward inputs.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, conversion-first presentation with no visible motion system implied. Any motion would likely be limited to lightweight banner or form micro-interactions rather than narrative animation.
designNotes: Structure is optimized for lead generation rather than storytelling.
Use strong contrast in the hero to establish urgency and authority.
Keep feature sections modular and scannable with short subheads and bullet-like detail.
Repeat the primary conversion action without creating multiple competing paths.
Favor utility and clarity over decorative embellishment.
If adapting to a generative AI landing page, preserve the same lead-capture-first sequencing: hero, proof points, form, then product capabilities.

personality.buyer: Creative directors, video producers, art directors, and enterprise marketing teams
personality.reasoning: This product is about high-quality AI image and video generation, so the visual language should feel cinematic and intelligent rather than generic SaaS. The brand colors are already bold and warm, so the identity should lean into a confident orange-led palette with clean neutrals and high contrast. The layout should showcase dual product paths, dense feature depth, and enterprise trust without becoming cluttered. Because the audience includes creative professionals, the page should feel polished, visually expressive, and slightly experimental, while still reading as a serious B2B decision page.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The headline is long, so it needs to compress to maintain balance in a split cinematic hero without breaking lines awkwardly.

colours.colourReason: The brand already defines orange as the primary identity color, so the hero and primary CTA must use it directly. White, near-black, and soft grey support the visual system cleanly, keeping the page premium and letting product visuals and data cards carry the detail.

backgroundSystem.hero: solid #ff6b00 with subtle dark overlay and soft radial mesh accents

layout.heroBackground: Orange-led split hero with text on the left and layered product composition on the right
layout.heroReason: The product benefits from a split layout because the audience needs both persuasion and a strong visual demo feel. The right side should simulate AI outputs, model chips, and floating output cards to communicate generation quality immediately.
layout.featureReason: The page contains two major product streams—image generation and video generation—so alternating section treatments create stronger contrast, improve scanability, and prevent a long feature page from feeling repetitive.
layout.darkSectionFor: Seedance 1.5 Pro video generation section, to create a cinematic contrast and emphasize motion, audio-visual sync, and storytelling

personality.imageryDirection: Use layered AI-generated creative previews, abstract model interface shells, floating prompt chips, and cinematic output mockups. For the hero, combine a large stylized visual panel with a few stacked output cards showing image generations, video frames, audio waveform cues, and model labels. Use PNG for UI/product compositions and JPEG only for broad atmospheric hero backdrops. Keep visuals crisp, high-contrast, and premium.
personality.designPersonality: Cinematic and intelligent with an orange-led brand signature, layered product storytelling, precise typography, and strong section contrast. Feels like an enterprise-grade AI creative platform built for professionals who care about quality, control, and speed.

designIntent.audience: Professionals seeking high-quality AI image and video generation, including creative directors, video producers, art directors, and enterprises
designIntent.primaryUserIntent: Evaluate ByteDance's generative AI capabilities for professional image and video production, then take the primary action to generate with AI or request a demo/quote for enterprise use

brandDirection.tone: Expert, performance-led, and enterprise-trustworthy with a clear innovation edge
brandDirection.visualStyle: Dark promotional hero with strong contrast, followed by clean white feature sections and structured utility panels; minimal ornamentation, dense content blocks, and conversion-focused hierarchy

sectionPurpose.purpose: Establish immediate value proposition, communicate both image and video generation capabilities, and drive the primary conversion path
Explain Seedream 4.5 as the image-generation offer with capability depth and professional use-case confidence
Explain Seedance 1.5 Pro as the video-generation offer with multimodal, synchronized output benefits
Convert high-intent buyers by framing commercial packaging and quote-based purchase entry points
Reinforce professional credibility through role-based endorsements from creative and production stakeholders

componentNeeds.variantHint: dark promotional hero with left-aligned copy and compact feature bullets
componentNeeds.notes: Prioritize headline, supporting line, and a tight value-prop list. Use one primary CTA only. Since no secondary CTA exists, keep the hero action path singular and strong.
Translate the extras into concise proof bullets: AI image generation, AI video generation with audio, multimodal content creation, enterprise-ready infrastructure.

componentNeeds.variantHint: stacked feature intro with supporting card grid
componentNeeds.notes: Treat as a detailed product block with one lead statement and supporting capability cards. Use strong typography hierarchy for scanability.
Six feature items should be grouped into a clean grid. Keep cards functional and text-dense, not decorative.

componentNeeds.variantHint: stacked feature intro with supporting card grid
componentNeeds.notes: Mirror the Seedream section but visually distinguish it through labeling and capability emphasis on synchronized audio-video generation.
Use six feature items; keep the technical capabilities easy to scan and avoid overcrowding individual cards.

componentNeeds.variantHint: 2-up comparison style cards with quote CTA
componentNeeds.notes: No discount or EMI data is provided. Present as quote-oriented commercial cards with clear includes list and CTA prominence.
Only use the valid testimonials provided. Ignore the incomplete placeholder quote. Include role-forward attribution and strong quote styling.

layoutStrategy.hero: Use a full-width dark hero band with strong contrast, a large left-aligned headline, concise supporting copy, and compact bullet proof points beneath. Keep the CTA prominent and single-path. Ensure the opening communicates both image and video generation in one scan.
layoutStrategy.features: Use stacked product sections with clear labels for Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro. Each section should begin with a strong title and summary paragraph, followed by a dense but organized 3-column feature grid on desktop and single-column stacking on mobile.
layoutStrategy.proof: Use testimonials as the primary credibility layer after features. Style them as direct, role-based validation for creative and production buyers. Keep the testimonial section visually lighter than the feature sections but still structured and authoritative.
layoutStrategy.pricing: Use quote-oriented pricing cards rather than transactional e-commerce pricing. Since one plan has a starting monthly price and the other is quote-based, maintain a comparison feel but avoid overcomplicating the layout with discounts or payment affordances.
layoutStrategy.form: No form section should be introduced because includeForm is false. Conversion should route through CTAs in hero, feature blocks, and pricing cards.

designIntent.tokenProfileHint: Use default Techjockey typography pairing for a generative AI/productivity product: Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Inter for body. Lean into a dark hero with accent-driven CTAs, white feature cards, subtle elevation, and restrained motion. Use Techjockey trust cues where relevant without inventing unsupported badges or claims.
designIntent.figmaReadySummary: Design a high-density, conversion-led single-product landing page for professional generative AI buyers. Lead with a dark split hero that unifies image and video generation value, then flow into two clearly separated product feature sections, followed by quote-oriented pricing cards and role-based testimonials. Keep the interface utility-first, text-forward, and structured for fast scanning. No form, no award bar, no invented trust badges, and no extra sections beyond the supplied content.

figmaBuildPlan.tokenProfileHint: default / marketing / AI-product landing page; use Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Inter for body; dark hero with white text, accent CTA, clean utility cards, light grey trust and testimonial separations

sections.variantHint: dark hero with left-aligned copy stack and compact value-prop bullets; no secondary CTA content if empty in source
sections.notes: Build as a full-width hero with strong dark background. Include brand/logo placement area at top, large headline, subheadline, supporting line, primary CTA, and a compact bullet list using extras: AI Image Generation, AI Video Generation with Audio, Multimodal Content Creation, Enterprise-ready AI infrastructure. Use a two-column split only if a media asset is later supplied; otherwise keep the copy column dominant with a slim supporting panel reserved for bullet/value props. Secondary CTA should not be fabricated because source is empty.

sections.variantHint: light grey separator band with centered utility bullets and thin dividers
sections.notes: Because explicit badges, social proof, and customer count are absent, use a minimal trust/value strip derived from supplied extras only. Keep it compact and aligned to the page rhythm. Do not invent customer counts or badge logos. Present the four provided value props as a horizontal flex row with simple separators.

sections.variantHint: feature intro with supporting copy and 6-card feature grid
sections.notes: Render as a product-focused section with a clear section label, headline, description, primary CTA, and a 3-column grid of feature cards. Since there are 6 features, use a 3-column grid with 2 rows on desktop per design memory. Each card should be functional and utility-oriented with border, radius, and consistent padding. Preserve the long-form intro text above the card grid. Use no decorative imagery unless later provided.

sections.variantHint: feature intro with supporting copy and 6-card feature grid
sections.notes: Render as the second product block with the same structural system as Seedream, but allow a slightly different label treatment because the source label is 'Additional Feature:-'. Keep the section visually consistent with the first product block to reinforce a single product family. Use a 3-column grid with 6 feature cards. No CTA should be added if the source CTA is empty.

sections.variantHint: two centered pricing cards with quote-oriented conversion behavior, no fabricated pricing for empty fields
sections.notes: Build a two-card pricing section even though one plan has no price. For Seedance, display the provided starting price. For Seedream, treat as request-quote pricing with no amount shown. Keep cards centered and utility-focused. Include plan name, price area, included checklist, and Get Quote CTA. Do not add discount/original price/EMI because they are not supplied.

sections.variantHint: 3-column testimonial grid, ignore malformed placeholder entry
sections.notes: Use only the valid testimonial entries. Exclude the placeholder entry with quote 'T' because it is incomplete. Each testimonial card should use the design-system testimonial pattern with star row, italicized quote, bold author name, and grey designation/company line. Keep the section on a very light grey or subtly tinted background for separation.

sections.variantHint: single-column mobile hero with stacked text and CTA; value-prop bullets below
sections.notes: On mobile, stack content vertically with text first since no media is supplied. Keep the hero compact but high-impact, with full-width primary CTA and any supporting bullets beneath. Secondary CTA remains absent. Reduce line length and preserve clear hierarchy for the 39-word headline by allowing controlled wrapping.

sections.variantHint: stacked bullet list with dividers removed
sections.notes: Convert the desktop trust strip into a single-column stacked utility list. Maintain compact spacing and avoid introducing iconography not present in source. This section should read as reinforcement, not a full testimonial or badge bar.

Collapse the 6 feature cards into a single-column vertical list for mobile. Keep the intro copy followed by each card in sequence. Ensure cards remain visually consistent with the desktop design system. CTA, if used, should be full-width and placed after the intro copy, before the feature cards or at the end of the section depending on available vertical space.

Maintain the same mobile treatment as the Seedream section. Keep the feature cards stacked in one column, and omit CTA placement if none is supplied. Use consistent paddings and spacing tokens so the section feels like part of the same system.

sections.variantHint: two stacked quote cards with full-width CTAs
sections.notes: Stack pricing cards vertically on mobile. The Seedream card remains quote-oriented with no price value, while Seedance includes the provided starting price. Keep CTA full-width and stack any supporting notes beneath the checklist. Do not add EMI or trust line because not provided in source.

Present testimonials as a vertical stack of cards. Remove the incomplete placeholder testimonial entry. Preserve the star rating row and author hierarchy. If space becomes constrained, allow this section to be vertically scrollable within its own frame only if necessary for Figma layout clarity.

figmaExecutionNotes: Use a single design-system token set across desktop and mobile; do not create one-off section styles.
Keep the page linear and lead-gen focused: hero -> trust -> product features -> pricing -> testimonials.
Use dark hero styling with white text and strong accent CTA; avoid a white hero background.
Treat both product sections as sibling feature blocks with the same grid system to reinforce product-family coherence.
Do not fabricate unsupported trust badges, customer counts, pricing discounts, or secondary CTAs.
Exclude the malformed testimonial placeholder entry with quote 'T'.
On mobile, collapse all grids to one column and make CTAs full-width.
Use 16/24/32/48/64 spacing tokens consistently; section padding should feel spacious but efficient.
